query: SELECT id, codigoQuarto, DATE_FORMAT(dataRegistro, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i') as data, ordem FROM quartos WHERE YEAR(dataRegistro) = 2025 AND MONTH(dataRegistro) = 11 ORDER BY dataRegistro, ordem LIMIT 20
